title: Development of postoperative delirium prediction models in patients undergoing cardiovascular surgery using machine learning algorithms.
summary: Five classifiers predicted postoperative delirium among 87 cardiovascular-surgery patients; 24 developed delirium. Stratified fivefold cross-validation gave Extra-Trees AUROC .76 (SD .11); XGBoost had the highest reported sensitivity, .67.
ai_technology: Bernoulli naive Bayes, SVM, random forest, Extra-Trees and XGBoost models using preoperative and intraoperative factors.
